_comment: TDD M4 reverse named-effort slice: explicit null reasoning means absent (null policy), so no upstream reasoning field and no loss. GREEN on baseline and must stay GREEN after impl (source: Responses null policy skips null reasoning). Independent null control beside the no-control baseline.
name: m4_reasoning_responses_chat_null_reasoning_no_control
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-resp"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
